edges: The hurricane moved out to sea after impacting New England.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The hurricane caused torrential rainfall and crop devastation in Edgartown.
The hurricane made landfall at the mouth of the Cape Fear River in North Carolina on 22 August 1806.

multi_hop_neighbors.neighbor: East Coast of the United States
multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The 1806 Great Coastal hurricane impacted the East Coast of the United States.
The hurricane inflicted widespread damage in Wilmington, North Carolina.
The hurricane arrived at the Bahamas on 19 August 1806.
The hurricane produced strong gusts in the vicinity of New York City.
The 1806 Great Coastal hurricane caused severe rainfall and damage in Massachusetts.
The hurricane caused severe damage to crops and salterns in Brewster.
The hurricane caused the sinking of the Rose-in-Bloom offshore of Barnegat Inlet, resulting in 21 deaths.
The hurricane caused significant damage in Charleston, South Carolina.
